title: I’d like more options for my alarm sound
body:
While we work on incorporating more sound options directly into the app, you have the ability to import any audio file from your iPhone to use as a custom alarm sound.

There are thousands of free alarm tones available on the internet. The best source that we’ve found is a website called Zedge (zedge.net). Search things like ‘alarm’ ‘gentle wake up’, or even a specific song.

Once you’ve downloaded an audio file to your iPhone, navigate to the Lasso app’s Settings > Sound menu. Tap ‘Import Sound,’ find your audio file in the file picker, then select ‘Custom’ instead of ‘Default.’
